name: A-level Biology (AQA 7402)

selected_options.practical_endorsement: not covered (teacher-assessed, separate from the grade)

material_vintage: AQA AS and A-level Biology (7401/7402) specification, Version 1.6 (July 2026), linked from aqa.org.uk/7402 and itemised on 2026-09-27: every content code at its deepest level (3.1.1-3.8.4.3), the mathematical requirements MS 0.1-4.1, the practical skills PS1.1-4.1, the apparatus and techniques ATa-l and the twelve required practicals. The hands-on apparatus list (practical endorsement only) is declared out of scope. Assessment: Paper 1 (2 h, 91 marks, 35%: topics 1-4), Paper 2 (2 h, 91 marks, 35%: topics 5-8), Paper 3 (2 h, 78 marks, 30%: topics 1-8; 38 marks structured questions including practical techniques, 15 marks critical analysis of experimental data, and a 25-mark essay from a choice of two titles). Stage tests and the mock are original questions in AQA's style; every numerical answer and statistic was computed when the course was built.
level_source: RQF Level 3 (GCE A-level), per Ofqual's register listing for AQA 7402

learner_notices.text: The A-level grade comes only from the written papers. AQA also reports a separate practical endorsement, assessed by a teacher watching you work in a lab. This course teaches the required practicals' methods, analysis and evaluation for the written papers, but it cannot award or replace the endorsement.

Biology answers often use diagrams (cell structures, graphs, the heart). In this course they are described in words; practise sketching and labelling each one on paper as you go, since the exam may ask you to draw them.
